name: Akiris Reed
summary: Along the beaches of the Cape of Stranglethorn, naga gather Akiris Reed, a valuable ocean plant. Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay offers good pay for bundles of it.

sections.title: Reed from the Shore
sections.body: Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay pays for bundles of Akiris Reed gathered along the northern beach. The naga call the ocean reed akiris, and Bloads says his friend Groy makes a good living selling it. What Groy uses the reed for, Bloads does not know; for him, ten stalks are enough to begin a profitable trade.

faq.answer: Akiris Reed is a valuable ocean reed gathered by naga along the Cape of Stranglethorn's beaches.
Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay pays for bundles of Akiris Reed on behalf of his friend Groy.

faq.q: What does Groy use the reed for?
faq.answer: Privateer Bloads says he does not know what Groy uses Akiris Reed for; he only knows Groy sells it at a profit.

faq.q: Where can I find Akiris Reed?
faq.answer: Naga gather Akiris Reed along the beaches north of Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
